item.title: Kosciusko BZA Addresses Petitions For Several Residences
item.description: The Kosciusko County Board of Zoning Appeals addressed petitions for several residences in the county during a Tuesday, Feb. 10, board meeting.

item.title: Downtown Warsaw Sip N Shop Returns This Friday, Feb. 13
item.description: The community is invited for an evening of shopping, sipping and socializing at the Downtown Warsaw Sip N Shop from 5–7 p.m. Friday, Feb. 13.

item.title: Indiana Governor Calls For Tougher Controls On Social Media
item.description: A sharp rise in online tips about child exploitation led to hundreds of arrests and dozens of rescues in Indiana last year, but state leaders warn that predators are becoming harder to track.

item.title: Report Shows Continued Growth In Elkhart County Tourism, Hospitality Industry
item.description: Elkhart County’s tourism and hospitality industry is sustaining an upward trajectory, joining the state of Indiana’s robust growth, according to data recently released by the Indiana Destination Development Corp.

item.title: New Year, New Risks: AG Rokita Warns Hoosiers About January’s Dangerous Recalls
item.description: Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita is warning Hoosiers about consumer safety risks tied to products recalled in January and urging residents to take action if they purchased affected items.

item.title: Yakym, Moore Introduce Bipartisan Affordable Housing Bond Enhancement Act
item.description: Congressman Rudy Yakym and Congresswoman Gwen Moore of Wisconsin introduced on Tuesday, Feb. 10, the Affordable Housing Bond Enhancement Act, which would make home ownership more accessible and sustainable for working families.

item.title: America in the 1770s: How Colonists Turned Protest Into Nation-Building and War
item.description: The 1770s were a decade of argument and action in America, as 13 British colonies moved from protest to a declared break with the empire.

item.title: Indiana Approves Honoring Bob Knight By Renaming Highway Near IU
item.description: The Indiana Legislature has unanimously approved a plan to rename a stretch of SR 45 near Indiana University’s Assembly Hall after the late men’s basketball coach Bob Knight.
